svg.title: XIU — We build small, and run it properly.
svg.desc: XIUSoft makes LiveSSH, an SSH and SFTP client, and Bosong, a gentle mood diary. XIU the puppy sleeps on a mint cushion under a crescent moon.

g.text: We build small, and run it properly.
A small software company making web, mobile and desktop apps,
and running them ourselves after launch.
user@host and you are in. File transfers, tmux resume, AI-agent approvals.
